info.text:
One hack stole more crypto than hackers took in all of 2025.
On Oct 29, hackers drained about $6.3 billion from Binance in about 20 minutes, the largest crypto theft on record.
Chainalysis counted $3.4 billion stolen in all of 2025; the old single-hack record was Bybit's $1.5 billion.
The FBI blamed North Korea. Binance began reopening withdrawals Nov 1 and says it replaced about 95% with its own funds.
Crypto on an exchange isn't FDIC insured; bank deposits are covered up to $250,000.
Sources: CNBC, Bloomberg, FBI via ABC/RTE, Chainalysis, FDIC.
News and education, not financial advice.
